name: Humanizer Prompt
user_prompt_template: Your task is to optimize the readability of a given article based on established readability formulas. The goal is to make the content highly accessible while preserving the original meaning. 1. Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level Formula: 0.39 x (words / sentences) + 11.8 x (syllables / words) - 15.59 Target: 1-4 (Elementary level) Example Before Optimization (Higher Grade Level - Difficult to Read): "The confluence of multiple external factors and internal variables culminates in an intricate process requiring meticulous analysis and evaluation." Example After Optimization (Higher Grade Level - Easy to Read): "Many things affect the process, so we must think and check carefully." 2. Gunning Fog Score Formula: 0.4 x ((words/sentences) + 100 x (complex words/words)) Target: 5-6 (Simple, clear writing) Example Before Optimization: "The fundamental conceptualization of this hypothesis necessitates comprehensive scrutiny and intellectual discernment." Example After Optimization: "We need to think carefully about this idea." 3. SMOG Index Formula 1.0430 × Square Root of (Number of Polysyllabic Words × (30 / Total Sentences)) + 3.1291 Target: 3-5 (Easy readability) Example Before Optimization: "Utilizing an intricate methodology enhances the precision and reliability of the experimental results.” Example After Optimization: "Using a simple method makes results more accurate.” 4. Coleman-Liau Index Formula 0.0588 x (letters / words x 100) - 0.296 x (sentences/words x 100) 15.8 Target: 5-6 (Short, clear words) Example Before Optimization: "The utilization of appropriate instruments facilitates an efficacious completion of designated objectives." Example After Optimization: "Using the right tools helps get the job done" 5. Automated Readability Index (ARI) Formula 4.71 x (characters/words) + 0.5 x (words/sentences) - 21.43 Target: 1-3 (Very easy to read) Example Before Optimization: "It is imperative that we systematically evaluate the components before proceeding." Example After Optimization: "We must check everything before moving forward." Optimization Guidelines: • Use short sentences (aim for 10 words or fewer per sentence). • Use simple words (avoid words with three or more syllables unless necessary) • Prefer active voice over passive voice. • Avoid jargon & technical terms unless absolutely necessary • Use a conversational tone to enhance engagement and comprehension. Output Format: 1.Provide the improved version of the text. 2.***Must not use em dashes (—) anywhere in your response***. 3. output only the optimized text. 4. ***Must not optimized heading text*** 5. ***Do not remove URL link on a keyword. That linked keyword must be as it is. You can optimize the linked keyword sentence but the linked keyword must be retain*** 6.DO NOT change anything inside html block.7. No text before H1 8. No text after final conclusion paragraph. 9. Output the article only. ---Here is the article text --- {{ARTICLE}}
